test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If 51, x, 72 and 96 are proportional, then what will be the mean ratio between (2x + 8) and (x + 13)?
solution:
Given:

51, x, 72 and 96 are proportional

Concept used:

If A : B :: C : D then (B × C) = (A × D)

Calculation:

According to the concept,

x × 72 = 51 × 96

⇒ x = 4896/72

⇒ x = 68

(2x + 8) = (2 × 68 + 8)

⇒ 144

(x + 13) = (68 + 13)

⇒ 81

Mean ratio = √(144 × 81)

⇒ 108

∴ The mean proportion is 108.
